meta.query_interpretation: Interpreted as a relationship question, rendered as a network graph.
assumptions: Interpreted "network of sponsors and drugs" as a sponsor-drug relationship graph.
Interpreted "melanoma trials" as trials for the condition melanoma.
warnings: Fetched 600 of 3,743 matching trials (capped at max_studies=600); figures below describe that sample, not the full result set.
Merged brand and generic names into 15 shared compound node(s) using RxNorm; each merged node lists its source names.
Graph truncated to 40 nodes for readability, by retaining the busiest sponsors first, then the drugs those sponsors study.
Node sizes count the trials supporting a drawn connection, so a node pruned away takes its trials with it: a node here can be smaller than the full fetched sample would make it.
